signedOut.title: Sign in to see your account here
signedOut.body: This page shows your FlexiLingo account. Sign in with your email or Google to see it.

source.localNote: You are signed out, so these numbers come from this computer only. Sign in to see your account's numbers.

learning.mirrored: Saved to your account and kept on this computer too.
learning.signedOutNote: You are signed out: these choices are saved on this computer only.
learning.notAppLanguage: This sets what you study and the language of translations. The app's own language is chosen in Settings, General.
learning.conflictTitle: This computer uses a different language pair
learning.conflictBody: This computer: {{local}}. Your account: {{account}}. Nothing was changed.
learning.keepLocal: Save this computer's languages to my account
learning.offerPush: Your account has no languages yet. This computer uses {{local}}.

voice.deskNote: On this computer the natural voice, Google and FlexiLingo voices play as one online voice (when you are signed in); your device's voice works offline. Your choice is saved to your account for the website and the extension.

profile.tooBig: That picture is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.

subscription.openedInBrowser: Payment opened in your browser. Come back here when you finish; this page updates by itself.
subscription.notYet: No change yet. If you just paid, it can take a minute.

redeem.title: Have a gift code?
redeem.hint: Paste the code, or the whole link from your email.
redeem.invalid: That does not look like a gift code or link.

shared.title: Decks shared with you
shared.body: When a friend shares a review with you, it appears with your decks. Follow each other first, then share from a deck.

links.title: Share links
links.body: Create a link to one of your decks from the deck's page, and manage it there.

oauth.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser...
oauth.hint: A browser window opened. Choose your Google account there; this window continues by itself.

errors.GOOGLE_TIMEOUT: Sign-in took too long and was stopped. Try again.
errors.GOOGLE_STATE_MISMATCH: The browser answer did not match this sign-in. Try again.
errors.GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not set up in this version. Use your email.
errors.GOOGLE_OPEN_FAILED: Could not open your browser. Use your email instead.
errors.GOOGLE_LISTEN_FAILED: Could not wait for the browser on this computer. Use your email instead.
errors.GOOGLE_TOKEN_FAILED: Google did not accept the sign-in. Try again.
errors.GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_FAILED: Google sign-in did not work. Try again or use your email.

whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.subtitle: Everything FlexiLingo can do, newest first.
